quotes.text: Learn about EU regulations requiring customer choice for co-badged cards.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: All available card networks must be clearly identified during the checkout process.

To enable card brand choice in the Combined Card Element, set [hideIcon](https://docs.stripe.com/js/elements_object/create_element?type=card#elements_create-options-hideIcon) to `false` or `undefined`.
To enable card brand choice in the Split Card Element, set [showIcon](https://docs.stripe.com/js/elements_object/create_element?type=cardNumber#elements_create-options-showIcon) to `true`.
To enable card brand choice with `on_behalf_of`, you must use iOS SDK 23.27.1 or later on iOS, or Android SDK 20.42.0 or later on Android.

findings: The November same-URL capture is an index of ten UI/platform variant links, not a replacement factual guide: new lines 9-24 route Checkout/Payment Links, four Web Elements, four Mobile Elements, and Terminal. The old lines 8-475 contain the actual regulation scope, integration instructions, warnings, examples and tests; the new index contains none of those behavioral claims. Omission in the default render is not deprecation, policy repeal, or confirmation that the May instructions remain current.

The old page already identifies variant URLs next to its sections (old 71-75, 80-84, 125-129, 178-182, 209-213, 232-236, 291-295, 350-354, 380-384, 415-419). The new index points to corresponding variants, so the structural change is from one all-variant capture to a navigation-only default page. Do not add the new index raw to factual raw_files or use its labels as evidence for current SDK behavior.

Existing source lines 13-27 summarize substantive May evidence but should explicitly date those details to the 2026-05-01 capture and add the November index only as navigation. The current source line 24 overgeneralizes mobile Connect setup: the old Mobile Card Element path requires `onBehalfOf` on the Card Element variant with iOS 23.27.1+/Android 20.42.0+, whereas the 23.22.1+/20.37.4+ baseline and IntentConfiguration path describe other mobile variants (old 232-259, 291-318, 350-399). This correction is independently supported by the old raw, not by the new index.

Existing source line 22 says Web Card Element needs `hideIcon: false`, which describes the Combined Card Element; the Split Card Element instead needs `showIcon: true` (old 125-132). The source should distinguish those variants in a later authorized edit. Old lines 155-163 also warn that the Card Element dropdown is incompatible with Sources and constrain `preferredNetwork` with icon display and no confirmation-time network override.

Existing source lines 13 and 21-24 broadly say Connect needs onBehalfOf. In the old guide this is conditional on Connect platforms using on_behalf_of with separate charges and transfers or destination charges, with different placement per integration (old 89-93, 141-145, 187-191, 218-222, 257-261, 316-320, 395-399). The concept route wiki/concepts/co-badged-cards.md similarly states the broader form; it should retain the condition and per-variant placement when next updated.

Preserve the old eligibility scope and terminal distinctions as dated May claims: online EEA Cartes Bancaires co-badged EUR, France in-person Cartes Bancaires, Germany in-person Girocard (old 18-26), and WisePad 3/S700/S710 selection versus manual Tap to Pay on iPhone requested_priority before tap (old 415-421). The new index cannot independently revalidate merchant eligibility or these integration rules.
substantive_changes: The default URL now renders a navigation index of ten variant URLs instead of the prior combined 475-line content (old 8-475; new 9-24); this is a source presentation and provenance change, not evidence of a change in the underlying regulation or SDK behavior.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain the 2026-05-01 full raw as dated factual evidence for the regulation's three choice requirements, EEA/France/Germany scope and each integration path (old 8-475); do not discard it because the new default page is short.
Keep old Web Card Element caveats: Combined hideIcon false/undefined, Split showIcon true, Sources incompatibility, and conditional currency behavior (old 125-163).
Keep the old mobile Card Element Connect higher SDK minimum and onBehalfOf placement distinct from Payment Sheet/Embedded Payment Element conditions (old 232-399).
Keep the old test data and processing-network lookup as dated examples, not proof of live enablement or successful routing (old 429-475).
conflicts: Source line 22 collapses Combined and Split Web Card Element icon settings into hideIcon:false; old raw lines 131-132 require separate showIcon:true for Split.

Source line 24 collapses all mobile Connect behavior into IntentConfiguration at iOS 23.22.1+/Android 20.37.4+; old raw lines 395-399 give Mobile Card Element a different onBehalfOf location and higher iOS 23.27.1+/Android 20.42.0+ minimum.

Source line 13 and concept wiki/concepts/co-badged-cards.md under Stripe Integration say Connect broadly requires onBehalfOf; old raw lines 89-93, 141-145, 187-191 and 218-222 tie this to particular on_behalf_of charge patterns and merchant-of-record detection. The new index supplies no contrary or confirming behavioral evidence.
unresolved_questions: The ten linked November variant pages were not part of this pinned four-file review, so current variant-specific applicability, API options, SDK minimums and any post-May changes remain unverified.
The new index and old full guide do not establish whether a specific merchant is eligible; the old guide explicitly routes account-specific applicability to sign-in (old 14-16).

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/co-badged-cards-compliance, the November capture says the article has multiple variants and lists ten variant URLs (new lines 9-24). The earlier capture contains the full regulation and integration guide, with variant URLs embedded at each section (old lines 8-75 and 80-419). Thus [[source-stripe-co-badged-cards-compliance]] should retain its May factual raw as dated evidence and treat the new default page as navigation, not as proof that co-badged choice or an integration path was removed.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/co-badged-cards-compliance, [[source-stripe-co-badged-cards-compliance]] needs narrow accuracy corrections based on the older full guide even though the new capture is only an index (new lines 9-24). The older guide distinguishes Combined Card Element hideIcon from Split Card Element showIcon (old lines 125-132), and gives Mobile Card Element Connect a higher SDK minimum and onBehalfOf on the element variant (old lines 380-399). Preserve these qualifications and do not infer current merchant eligibility from the navigation page.
